# Revenue Enablement

> Revenue Enablement is a free web app and AI connector with twelve sales tools, by Shashwat Ghosh of Helix GTM Consulting, for CROs and demand generation heads. Give it an account, a deal or a competitor, and it drafts account plans, discovery questions, ROI business cases, emails and demo scripts. Add https://revenue-enablement.gtmhelix.com/mcp in Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code and Windsurf, no sign-in. In ChatGPT, you can also install the Helix Sales Enablement plugin from the ChatGPT plugin directory: https://chatgpt.com/plugins/plugin_asdk_app_6ae09b7a8e1c81919e201e1ae39b86f2

- Web app (no sign-in): https://revenue-enablement.gtmhelix.com/
- MCP server URL (Streamable HTTP, no sign-in, read-only tools): https://revenue-enablement.gtmhelix.com/mcp
- Connect to Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf: https://revenue-enablement.gtmhelix.com/connect/
- Use it in ChatGPT: install the Helix Sales Enablement plugin from the ChatGPT plugin directory: https://chatgpt.com/plugins/plugin_asdk_app_6ae09b7a8e1c81919e201e1ae39b86f2
- Docs (MCP and REST, every field): https://revenue-enablement.gtmhelix.com/docs/
- FAQ: https://revenue-enablement.gtmhelix.com/faq/
- Privacy policy: https://revenue-enablement.gtmhelix.com/privacy/
- Terms of use: https://revenue-enablement.gtmhelix.com/terms/
- Hosted version 1.2.32 with 12 tools. Local stdio command: `npx -y @shashwatgtmalpha/revenue-enablement-mcp`. npm latest on 15 November 2026: 1.2.30.
- Source code: https://github.com/shashwatgtm/revenue-enablement-mcp
- Built by: Shashwat Ghosh, Helix GTM Consulting (https://www.gtmexpert.com)

## Tools

- [Account Plan Builder](https://revenue-enablement.gtmhelix.com/tools/account-plan-builder/) (`account_plan_builder`): Helps you decide how to grow an account in the next 90 days. You give the account name, plus contacts, products, threats and notes if you have them. You get a strategic account plan: a power map with one row per contact you name, whitespace analysis, competitive questions, an answer for each objection and a 90 day plan. It does not look the account up.
- [Deal Strategy Coach](https://revenue-enablement.gtmhelix.com/tools/deal-strategy-coach/) (`deal_strategy_coach`): Helps you decide what to do next to move a deal. You give the deal name and stage, plus competitors, stakeholder positions and blockers. You get a deal health score, a strategy for the stage, next steps and risks to handle. Ask the user to confirm blocker status, economic buyer engagement, incumbent status and project status when those facts affect the score; typed facts take precedence over text.
- [Discovery Question Bank](https://revenue-enablement.gtmhelix.com/tools/discovery-question-bank/) (`discovery_question_bank`): Helps you decide what to ask on a discovery call. You give the framework you use (MEDDPICC, BANT, SPICED, Challenger, Gap Selling or all five) and what you already know about the prospect. You get an opening for the conversation, questions in the language of the prospect's sector and on what your solution covers, questions for each part of the framework, a closing and what to say to an objection. It uses only the inputs you give and says which it did not get.
- [ROI Business Case Builder](https://revenue-enablement.gtmhelix.com/tools/roi-business-case-builder/) (`roi_business_case_builder`): Helps you build an ROI case the buyer's finance team can check. You give your solution, its main value driver and the buyer's own figures: an annual value estimate, or current annual cost with the expected improvement percent. With them you get the ROI, payback, three year value and sensitivity. Without them it shows no ROI: it names the inputs to add and gives the structure of the case (the cost lines to price, your quoted results as reference points, the questions to ask). Ask finance for the cash-only annual benefit when an investment decision depends on cash.
- [Mutual Action Plan Generator](https://revenue-enablement.gtmhelix.com/tools/mutual-action-plan-generator/) (`mutual_action_plan_generator`): Helps you decide what has to happen, by whom and when, for a deal to sign on time. You give the deal name and the target close date, plus the current stage, the buyer's champion, economic buyer and evaluators, known requirements and process steps if you have them. You get a close plan both sides can work from, with milestones, owners and dates.
- [Win/Loss Analyzer](https://revenue-enablement.gtmhelix.com/tools/win-loss-analyzer/) (`win_loss_analyzer`): Helps you decide why you won or lost and what to change. You give the details of one deal, a competitor pattern or a set of deals. You get a short write up that names the outcome, the stated reason in the buyer's words, what the reason points to and what the buyer weighed, then questions for the review call and sector notes. It adds no figure or reason you did not give, and says what a missing outcome or reason would add.
- [Proposal Section Writer](https://revenue-enablement.gtmhelix.com/tools/proposal-section-writer/) (`proposal_section_writer`): Helps you write one section of a proposal for a named buyer. You give the section you need (such as an executive summary, solution overview or pricing justification), your solution, the buyer's challenges, your differentiators, pricing and success measures. You get that section in sentences built from your inputs, with sector notes. It invents no figure, customer or date, and says once which inputs were not given.
- [Email Sequence Generator](https://revenue-enablement.gtmhelix.com/tools/email-sequence-generator/) (`email_sequence_generator`): Helps you decide what to send, and when, to open or restart a conversation. You give the persona, stage and objective (prospecting, nurture, follow up or re engagement), plus your solution, the pain point, value proposition, proof and ask. You get each email with its subject, send day and body, and a note on what you did not give. No placeholder is left in a body, and no result or statistic is invented.
- [Demo Script Builder](https://revenue-enablement.gtmhelix.com/tools/demo-script-builder/) (`demo_script_builder`): Helps you decide what to show in a demo, and in what order. You give the demo type, the persona and the use case, plus the features you must show and the pains you name. You get a timed run from opening to close, with spoken lines and a step for each feature tied to the pains, then discussion, close and follow up lines and sector notes. The answer says where each step came from and what it did not get.
- [Pricing Negotiation Guide](https://revenue-enablement.gtmhelix.com/tools/pricing-negotiation-guide/) (`pricing_negotiation_guide`): Helps you decide how to answer a discount request without giving away margin. You give the negotiation scenario, plus deal value, the discount asked, each side's leverage and who approves. You get a leverage assessment, a value based negotiation strategy, answers to common pushback and a discount approval framework. Ask whether the user has authority to approve the proposed terms.
- [Champion Enablement Kit](https://revenue-enablement.gtmhelix.com/tools/champion-enablement-kit/) (`champion_enablement_kit`): Helps you give your champion what they need to sell internally. You give the asset you need (an executive brief, internal business case, objection responses or presentation talking points), your solution, the customer's situation and the objections you expect. You get the asset in the champion's voice with the recommendation, answers to likely questions, the decision requested, a note on the reader and sector notes. It invents no figure or quote.
- [Competitive Trap Setter](https://revenue-enablement.gtmhelix.com/tools/competitive-trap-setter/) (`competitive_trap_setter`): Helps you decide which questions expose the gaps in your main competitor, without negative selling. You give the named competitor, your solution, your strengths and its weak points as you know them. You get the set up, discovery questions, criteria to establish, reference call questions, requirement and scenario traps, commercial terms and tactics for your stage, with sector notes. Every line comes from your inputs and the sector, and none from an invented fact about the competitor.

## Questions and answers

### What is Revenue Enablement?

Revenue Enablement is a free web app and AI connector with twelve sales tools, by Shashwat Ghosh of Helix GTM Consulting, for CROs and demand generation heads. Give it an account, a deal or a competitor, and it drafts account plans, discovery questions, ROI business cases, emails and demo scripts. Add https://revenue-enablement.gtmhelix.com/mcp in Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code and Windsurf, no sign-in. In ChatGPT, you can also install the Helix Sales Enablement plugin from the ChatGPT plugin directory: https://chatgpt.com/plugins/plugin_asdk_app_6ae09b7a8e1c81919e201e1ae39b86f2

### Is Revenue Enablement free, and do I need an account?

It is free, and there is no account or sign-in. Use the tools in your browser here, or add them to Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code and Windsurf as a connector.

### Does it use AI to write the answers?

No. Each tool applies fixed rules in the Revenue Enablement code to the inputs you give it. It does not call an AI model and does not look anything up. When you use it from Claude or another assistant, that assistant writes around the tool's answer.

### What happens to what I type?

It is sent to this site's server, used once to build the answer, and dropped when the answer is sent back. What you type and the answer are not stored, and nothing you type is logged. Only an anonymous count of tool calls is kept. The privacy page has the details.

### How do I use Revenue Enablement in Claude?

In Claude, open Customize, then Connectors, select + and then Add custom connector. Name it Revenue Enablement, paste https://revenue-enablement.gtmhelix.com/mcp and leave the sign-in fields empty. The page Connect your app covers Claude Code, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code and Windsurf too.

### Who built it?

Shashwat Ghosh, Co-Founder and Fractional CMO of Helix GTM Consulting, the brand he has worked under in Bengaluru since 2022. He has 24+ years in B2B and 10+ years of fractional experience, and created the EPIC, IMPACT and CRAFT frameworks and the Hub-Spoke Brand Messaging Methodology.

### Why do some answers look like templates?

Several tools return a structured plan with [placeholders] where your inputs did not give a fact. When an answer shows a benchmark, target, rate, weight or other figure you did not supply, it is labelled "Example figure: replace with your own". Figures calculated from your inputs are not labelled. Suggested lengths, timings and counts are marked as suggestions. Replace every example and placeholder before you use the result.

### Can I call the tools from my own code?

Yes. Send POST https://revenue-enablement.gtmhelix.com/api/tools/<tool name> with a JSON body {"input": {...}}. The Docs page lists every field. Please keep to the rate limit of 30 requests per minute.

### Is the source code public?

Yes, at https://github.com/shashwatgtm/revenue-enablement-mcp under the MIT licence. The npm package @shashwatgtmalpha/revenue-enablement-mcp runs these tools locally; it can lag behind this site until a new version is published.

### Who is Revenue Enablement not ideal for?

Teams that want the tools to read their CRM, email or call notes: they work only from what you type. Sending anything straight to a buyer: every output is a draft for a person to review first. Teams that need saved deal history: answers are not stored, so keep each result in your own deal record.

### How do I report a problem?

Email shashwat@gtmhelix.com or open an issue at https://github.com/shashwatgtm/revenue-enablement-mcp/issues.

## Buyer routes

- [All Helix tools](https://tools.gtmhelix.com/tools/): 52 tools and 37 different skills, 89 in all, in six connectors and nine plugins.
- [Run a B2B win loss analysis](https://revenue-enablement.gtmhelix.com/tools/win-loss-analyzer/): Review a B2B deal you won or lost using what the buyer and deal records actually say. Enter the outcome, reasons and competitive context to organise the review. Separate confirmed facts from your interpretation, then use the patterns to choose questions for the next buyer interview and deal review.
- [Roi Business Case Builder](https://revenue-enablement.gtmhelix.com/tools/roi-business-case-builder/): Build a B2B sales business case using the costs and benefits the buyer can check. Enter the investment, annual benefit and planning period, then review return and payback alongside the assumptions. Take the draft to finance and confirm who owns each input before using it in an approval conversation.
- [Deal Strategy Coach](https://revenue-enablement.gtmhelix.com/tools/deal-strategy-coach/): Review a B2B deal that needs a clear next step. Supply the buying roles, decision process, risks and current stage, then check the proposed actions against what the buyer has confirmed. Use the result to prepare the next conversation and agree a dated action with the person who owns it.
